follow-up time: Third trimester of ex utero life
outcome: Regional CBF in the cerebral cortex, thalami, pons, and cerebellum
cohort: 78 preterm infants younger than 32 weeks' gestational age and <1500 g
finding: Preterm infants with brain injury had lower global and regional CBF, particularly in the thalamus and pons, suggesting regional vulnerability of the developing cerebro-cerebellar circuitry.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with lower regional CBF.
